SAN ANTONIO - As global headlines focus on the conflict in Iran, a group of South Texas high school seniors is preparing for a different kind of next step: enlisting in the U.S. Armed Forces after graduation. Our Community Salutes will host a gala Wednesday, May 13, at Pedrotti’s Ranch in Helotes to honor high school seniors from San Antonio and surrounding areas who have chosen to enlist.
Organizers said this year’s ceremony carries added significance as the students prepare to enter military service during what the group described as “one of the most significant periods of military engagement in recent history. ” The event is also intended to recognize the families supporting the students as they prepare for the transition.
Our Community Salutes invited media to cover the event and said it can coordinate one-on-one interviews with enlisting seniors and their families early in the evening before the main program begins. For newsrooms that cannot attend the full event, organizers said a media kit will be distributed by 8 p.m. and will include two sound bites and about one minute of b-roll footage.
Organizers also said crews are welcome to attend for late-evening live shots, with the atmosphere between 5:45 p.m. and 9:15 p.m. expected to provide a strong backdrop as the event wraps up. Our Community Salutes said there is still time for families to register an enlisting senior to be honored at the event. The organization is also asking community members to volunteer or donate.
